requirements.title: Use continuous copper geometry and native contact semantics
requirements.must: Validate entire swept segments against supported shapes and bounds. Clearance equality and electrical connectivity are separate predicates; tangency cannot falsely close a native open. Failed constrained search never falls back to reduced clearance, disabled via exclusions or another known-illegal result. Include same-net physical drill and mask spacing when those features are enabled.

verification: Mid-segment intrusion, crossings, rectangle corners, tangency/positive overlap and odd-width native controls.
Retained Carbon x=.0975 sampling case is the valid witness, not original prose x=.195.
Actual Rust-binary/native diagonal near-tangent regression and positive overlap controls; translated predicates alone do not prove binary behavior.
Same-net and cross-net drill, pad-hole and mask-web controls when supported.
requirements.current_evidence: 06ea2ca reproduced then corrected actual diagonal Rust false completion: 21/400 became 0, with 800 additional binary/native contact samples. Independent reviews accepted the bounded correction at 3a763b7. No universal rounding proof; conservative extra routing is possible. Operational native validation at0289d9f independently refuses native-disagreeing output before publication.

requirements.title: Report termination and bounded work honestly
requirements.must: Distinguish invalid, unsupported, exhausted and budget-exhausted. State that fixed net-order failure is not global infeasibility. Bound/cancel complete operations and report work as well as wall time. Same input, revision and work budget produce byte-identical edits; wall clock does not choose routes. An outer timeout must be reported as an edit-free failure, never completion.
requirements.implementation_owner: agent-1484 for Rust; agent-1497 for native/project acceptance
verification: Structured failure/exit controls, one total budget across nets, no partial edits.
Cancellation and per-phase bounded-work tests as orchestration expands.
Two-run deterministic edit comparison; total work/cancellation failures preserve the typed outcome and emit no edits.
requirements.current_evidence: Typed outcomes and total expansion budget pass; fixed-order reason corrected; full cancellation/work-cost bounds OPEN.

requirements.title: Represent native rules and geometry or refuse them
requirements.must: Import effective board/net/layer/local rules and supported geometry. Reject unrepresented projects, offsets, overrides, keepouts, copper graphics and other features explicitly. Never silently narrow required widths. Native Margin geometry must be represented or rejected at board and footprint levels. When zones are enabled, verify pour integrity, thermal contact and preserved existing connectivity after native refill.
requirements.implementation_owner: agent-1484 for Rust; agent-1497 for native/project acceptance
verification: Real native save/reload rejection cases plus supported geometry/control cases.
Native DRC beside original project/rule files when project import is supported.
Native board-level and footprint-level Margin rejection with a supported drawing control.
When zones are supported, native --refill-zones checks cover islands, area loss, thermal spoke survival and lost_fill_contact; no blanket assumption of net-equivalent copper.
requirements.current_evidence: Both reviews close Margin, local-rule omission and tiny-width objections within the accepted first subset. Native minimum added width and native DRC non-regression are mandatory at publication. Effective project rules, multilayer, vias and zones remain unsupported; all-track-errors and single-source snapshot follow-up review is pending.
